title: Cities: Skylines | Power, Politics, & Planning: Episode 4: Historic Urbanism 101
premise: Donoteat and bsquiklehausen present a three-century guide to American urban form for city builders, arguing that transport access, development finance, zoning, racial policy and redevelopment—not decorative props alone—produce the shape of believable cities.
coverage: Read the entire timestamped machine transcript and inspected all 36 contact sheets, all 424 indexed frames (5-second bins plus scene score >0.30 at 480px detection width). Inspected seven native 1920×1080 targeted stills at 205, 730, 748.5, 1155, 1195, 1765 and 1775 seconds. Additional QAIndustryLoopUrban evidence: native 1767s token crop; 6fps ending frames; spectrogram and AudioSet AST music/coin classification; all 80 low-threshold cuts inspected. QA observations are attributed, not counted as this author's inspected frames or direct listening. Full speech is renderer-derived; ASR opening Hi is mistimed to 3.13s although speech starts around 23–24s. Sound annotations use metadata/classifier provenance, not direct listening; empty arrays mean unannotated. Sparse sampling cannot guarantee every brief gag. Historical claims belong to presenters/editorial cards; arbitrary ASR turns and final adviser identity are not assigned.

sound.text: Unverified audio candidate: outtake music beneath conversation, apparently instrumental-only approximately 1761–1771s, based on QA AudioSet AST analysis. Track identity unconfirmed by listening. Timestamp marks continuation, not new onset.

panels.visualGag: Payoff/callback to 1374s SELECT ARCOLOGY menu and the credit conversation. The outrageous scale undercuts the earlier realistic-city advice while speakers joke about being stuck aboard a launching building and the Forest arcology looking dumb.
panels.notes: Image motion established across adjacent frames. Full speech remains renderer-derived.

panels.heading: You will regret cutting funding
panels.description: A SimCity 2000 warning dialog says YOU CAN’T CUT BACK ON FUNDING! YOU WILL REGRET THIS! with OK button. A DNE transit token covers the bearded adviser portrait; QA native crop at 1767s resolves GOOD FOR ONE FARE / DNE and a red diagonal band.
panels.camera: Fixed dialog framing; QA 6fps source frames establish vertical token movement, not camera movement.
panels.action: Token covers the face approximately 1764.5–1771.0s, then falls straight down past the OK button approximately 1771.2–1771.9s, revealing the portrait from about 1771.5s. Motion established by QAIndustryLoopUrban source-frame inspection, not this author's sparse stills.

sound.text: Unverified audio candidate: instrumental music continuing until approximately 1771s, suggested by QA AudioSet AST/spectrogram analysis. Track identity unconfirmed by listening; timestamp marks continuation.

Unverified audio candidate: acoustic transient approximately 1771.3–1774s coincides with token fall. QA spectrogram finds band-limited burst; AudioSet AST Coin (dropping) p=0.70 at 1771s, p=0.90 at 1772s suggests a coin-drop/clink. Event timing does not confirm effect identity; no direct listening.

panels.visualGag: A DNE transit token masks the imperious adviser, then literally drops off his face past OK. An unverified acoustic candidate coincides with the fall; a coin-drop audiovisual interpretation is plausible, not confirmed. Connected visual payoff is the unobscured portrait in the next panel; adviser identity not established.
panels.notes: QAIndustryLoopUrban resolved the token using native crop and 6fps source images. Those additional QA frames are not included in author's 424-frame/7-still inspection count.

panels.heading: The adviser gets the last word
panels.description: The same funding warning remains, now with an unobscured bespectacled bearded portrait.
panels.camera: Fixed dialog framing; the token has already fallen out of view, per QA source-frame sequence.
panels.action: Unobscured warning holds; QA source inspection reports fade around 1776s and black by approximately 1776.5s.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the DNE transit token covering and falling off the SimCity 2000 adviser at 1765–1772s: the face and unchanged YOU WILL REGRET THIS remain as the final admonition. The game source is recognizable; the portrait’s individual identity is not established.
panels.notes: Token fall and final fade reported by QAIndustryLoopUrban source-frame inspection. Sound here unannotated, not claimed silence.
